FSR-06.01, not yet fixed; the motion drawn is choreography

Ego slows at 3 m/s², the firm level of FSR-03.02 (DQ-019, DQ-033);
choreography, not Autoware's planned braking
Safety goals at stake

SG-02 (ASIL D): Decelerate at least as much as needed to avoid a
collision the planned trajectory avoids

SG-06 (ASIL D): Do not enter an intersection, roundabout or
crosswalk against right of way
Pass criterion

The vehicle enters only on a recognised green and treats an
unknown signal as red; whatever the signal, it does not enter when
its swept path crosses that of a detected road user before it
could stop or clear (FSR-06.01, FSR-06.03, FSR-02.01, FSR-02.02,
FSR-03.01, FM-05, AC-02)

Safety monitor's envelope (EL-02, ASIL D); length not computed: the vehicle is not chosen yet (DQ-008)
Meant to do: waits while its path is crossed
Dashed green: the path the pass criterion asks of the vehicle; green ring: where it is judged
Where the hazard lies: HE-06.1 Enters the intersection on red into crossing traffic
